title: What is BM25?
text: BM25 is a sparse ranking function based on term frequency, inverse document frequency, and document length normalization.

title: What are embeddings?
text: Embeddings are vectors that represent text. Similar texts should have similar vectors when the embedding model is useful.

title: Why use JSON output?
text: JSON output makes a retrieval command easy to call from scripts, notebooks, and language-model agents.
